verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own read APIs for transactions, accounts and statements, card expenses and receipts, accounting data, and travel trips. Its developer docs also include a recipe for a monthly CSV export of card transactions to Google Drive, though that recipe runs through Zapier. Together these give programmatic access to much of a customer's data, but nothing shows a first-party, complete, one-click export of all data in open formats designed for offboarding. Missing for 10: a documented native full-account export, explicit open-format coverage of all data types (CSV/JSON bulk dumps), and independent or hands-on confirmation that a complete export works when leaving.
